patch_list: Hides the Bookmarks, remote-connection and Category sections from the navigation sidebar, and hides Encrypt and Downloader from the Storage section.
Strips RsDownloadActivity's intent filters so it no longer offers itself as a handler in the system download/"complete action using" chooser.
Overrides show() on the in-app "rate us" dialog so it's still built but never displayed.
Hides Hide, Add to desktop, Encrypt, Decrypt, Add bookmark, Web Search, Copy to, Move to, Transfer, and Playing from the "More actions" menu.
Hide network, tools and bookmarks on home page
Hides the Network, Tools and Bookmarks sections from the home page section list.
Skips Splash Screen From 2nd App Opening
